resources.string: A sunlight-readable, low-power display made for the handlebars — not a repurposed phone screen.
No accounts, no cloud, no tracking. Every ride is stored only on this device.
GPS speed, distance, elevation and calories — plus optional heart-rate and cadence sensors.
InkRide uses your location to track rides via GPS. This data never leaves your device.
A notification keeps ride tracking running reliably while your screen is off.
